purpose: Define named nanoCMS web instances with stable logical identity separate from listen binding/runtime state, including canonical default instance `public` with reserved default port 80.

topics.name: Named nanoCMS Web Instance
topics.purpose: Define named nanoCMS web instances with stable logical identity separate from listen binding/runtime state, including canonical default instance `public` with reserved default port 80.

semantics.identity_rule: Each web/nanoCMS instance has an explicit stable logical name/identity.
semantics.binding_rule: Port/listen address is configuration binding, not instance identity.
semantics.runtime_rule: Declared instance identity/configuration exists independently from running/stopped state.
semantics.multi_rule: Multiple named nanoCMS instances may run concurrently on distinct valid bindings.
semantics.port_rule: `public` has port 80 as its default/reserved listen binding even when not currently running/enabled.
semantics.lifecycle_rule: Start/stop/reload changes runtime state without changing logical instance identity.
semantics.route_rule: Each instance hosts its own applicable site/route bindings.

invariants.rule: nanoCMS owns canonical web/site structure, routes, navigation and MetaModule placement/bindings; it never becomes owner of the placed MetaModule's semantics.

hard_gates.condition: port number used as web-instance identity
two active listeners conflict on same binding without validation
public instance absent from canonical configuration
port 80 default for public lost merely because instance is stopped

references.purpose: Port Editor manages named listener bindings.
Routes are scoped to named web instances.
